name: Quality management
description: Build consistent processes. Deliver better customer experiences.
scope: Process mapping, quality objectives, documented information, internal audit preparation and management review support.
headline: Make quality part of the way you work.
overview: ISO 9001 provides a framework for a quality management system. It helps an organisation connect customer requirements, operational processes and continual improvement. The focus is on how work is managed consistently, rather than certifying an individual product.
benefits: Clear responsibilities and repeatable processes
A structured approach to customer feedback
Better visibility of issues and corrective actions
A foundation for continual improvement
support: Map your processes and define the system scope
Agree quality objectives and process measures
Develop useful procedures and working records
Prepare your team for internal audits and management review
records: Process maps and responsibility matrix
Quality policy and measurable objectives
Operating procedures and monitoring records
Internal audit, review and corrective action records
question: Can a small business implement ISO 9001?
answer: Yes. The system should reflect the organisation?s size, activities and complexity. Our consultancy focuses on documentation and controls that are proportionate to your operations.

name: Environmental management
description: Manage your environmental impact with a practical, structured approach.
scope: Environmental aspect assessment, objectives, operational controls, awareness and internal audit support.
headline: Turn environmental goals into everyday action.
overview: ISO 14001 is a management system standard for identifying and managing environmental responsibilities. It provides a structured way to consider how activities affect the environment, plan controls and review environmental performance.
benefits: Greater understanding of environmental impacts
Clear ownership of environmental objectives
More consistent operational controls
A framework for tracking environmental improvement
support: Identify environmental aspects within your scope
Review how applicable obligations are identified and tracked
Develop objectives and practical operating controls
Prepare awareness, internal review and audit activities
records: Environmental aspects and impacts register
Environmental policy and objectives
Operational controls and monitoring records
Emergency preparedness and internal review records
question: Does ISO 14001 certification replace environmental permissions?
answer: No. A management system supports the way an organisation manages its responsibilities. Applicable permits, approvals and other obligations must still be identified and addressed separately.

name: Occupational health & safety
description: Put your people first with safer, healthier ways of working.
scope: Hazard identification, risk assessment, worker participation, operational procedures and audit preparation.
headline: A stronger system for safer work.
overview: ISO 45001 focuses on occupational health and safety management. It provides a framework for identifying hazards, managing risks and involving workers in improving workplace health and safety.
benefits: A systematic approach to workplace hazards
Stronger worker participation and communication
Clearer responsibilities for health and safety
More consistent review of incidents and improvements
support: Define scope and assess existing safety processes
Support hazard identification and risk assessment
Develop controls and worker consultation arrangements
Guide incident review, internal audits and readiness checks
records: Hazard identification and risk assessment records
Health and safety policy and objectives
Training, consultation and operational control records
Incident, corrective action and review records
question: Is ISO 45001 only for high-risk industries?
answer: No. Organisations with different types of work can use the framework. The hazards, controls and level of documentation should reflect the actual work and risk profile.

name: Information security
description: Protect information. Manage risk. Build stakeholder confidence.
scope: Information asset assessment, risk treatment, security policies, statement of applicability and audit readiness.
headline: Build confidence in how you protect information.
overview: ISO/IEC 27001 sets requirements for an information security management system. It uses a risk-based approach to managing information security, helping organisations protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information.
audience: Organisations managing business-critical or sensitive data
benefits: A clearer understanding of information risks
Defined ownership of security responsibilities
A consistent approach to selecting security controls
A framework for reviewing and improving security
support: Define the information security scope and context
Assess information risks and plan treatment
Support policies and the statement of applicability
Guide awareness, internal audit and management review
records: System scope and information asset records
Risk assessment and treatment plan
Statement of applicability and security policies
Monitoring, incident and internal review records
question: Is ISO 27001 only about IT systems?
answer: No. Information security also involves people, processes and physical arrangements. The management system considers relevant risks across the agreed organisational scope.

name: Food safety management
description: Bring a systematic approach to food safety across your operations.
scope: Food safety hazard analysis, prerequisite programmes, traceability, team awareness and audit preparation.
headline: Bring food safety into every stage of your process.
overview: ISO 22000 is a food safety management system standard for organisations in the food chain. It connects management system practices, communication and food safety hazard control in a structured approach.
audience: Food storage, transport and distribution businesses
Catering, hospitality and other food-chain organisations
benefits: Clearer food safety responsibilities
A systematic approach to food safety hazards
More consistent communication across the food chain
Structured monitoring and continual improvement
support: Understand your products, processes and scope
Support hazard analysis and control planning
Develop practical traceability and communication procedures
Prepare awareness, verification and audit readiness activities
records: Food safety policy and process flow information
Hazard analysis and control plans
Prerequisite programme and monitoring records
Traceability, verification and corrective action records
question: Can ISO 22000 apply beyond food manufacturing?
answer: Yes. It is intended for organisations in the food chain. The scope and implementation approach should reflect your activities and your role in food safety.

name: Energy management
description: Understand energy use and build a foundation for better performance.
scope: Energy review, baseline and performance indicators, action plans, monitoring and audit support.
headline: Make better energy performance a managed priority.
overview: ISO 50001 provides a framework for an energy management system. It helps organisations understand energy use, establish objectives and monitor progress in energy performance through a structured improvement cycle.
audience: Organisations seeking a structured energy management approach
benefits: Better visibility of energy use and consumption
Clear ownership of energy improvement actions
A basis for monitoring energy performance
A repeatable cycle for review and improvement
support: Define scope and support your energy review
Develop baseline and performance indicator approaches
Plan objectives, action plans and monitoring
Guide team awareness and internal audit preparation
records: Energy review and significant energy use records
Energy baseline and performance indicators
Energy policy, objectives and action plans
Monitoring, evaluation and review records
question: Does ISO 50001 guarantee a fixed energy saving?
answer: No fixed saving is guaranteed. Results depend on the organisation, its energy uses, selected actions and implementation. Consultancy helps establish a system for measuring and improving performance.
